title: Docker Desktop data
whyItMatters: Docker Desktop keeps its WSL2 disk and settings under LocalAppData. Containers can hold databases and application data not visible elsewhere.
source: Docker Desktop on Windows stores WSL2 VM data under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Docker/wsl (Docker Desktop documentation)
notes: Counts the docker_data.vhdx and settings by metadata; VHD contents are never opened. Unconfirmed: custom disk image locations configured in Docker Desktop are not matched.

cleanup.exportFirst: Push or export the images you still need, and copy database files out of the containers; the virtual disk is deleted with the uninstall.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Docker Desktop and of any registry accounts it holds, so the account stops trusting this machine.
steps: Close Docker Desktop and every running container.
Uninstall Docker Desktop from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Deletes the container images, containers, volumes and databases kept in Docker's virtual disk. None of it can be recovered from this PC.
